subject: reasoning
question: Mr. IJK starts from Point A and drives 23 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 27 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Mr. IJK starts from Point A and drives 23 km towards the south.

He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 27 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82739fc189283cfc0ab7b9a42443451a66df42192e90718c8ec29f978cb45324.png] 

Thus, IJK has to drive 4 km west to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
